summary: The verifier compares the complete report (blank_levels, every samples/ccvs/spikes entry, key sets, order, exact flags/booleans/nulls, numbers within the stated tolerance) for sealed batches, and each SOP rule and each 'keep shipped calculation' gap has a hand-built family whose expected outcome changes when the rule is wrong. The static traces found no reachable wrong implementation that would be accepted and no contract-valid alternative that would be rejected.
checks_performed: Read every file listed in packet-manifest.json in full; the manifest hashes show tests/shipped/tools/metalquant_run.py and environment/app/tools/metalquant_run.py are identical.

Traced compare() in tests/test_outputs.py:108-125. It checks the exact top-level key set, compares blank_levels as a dict (key order is free, as SOP 8 allows), and checks list lengths, per-entry key sets, and positional order. It uses exact type/value equality for id/analyte/flag/ccv_ok/pass/null value, and _number for recovery and non-null value, with a rel 1e-6 / abs 1e-6 (<1) bound matching instruction.md:7.

Hand-recomputed calibration.jsonl rows 1, 2 and 4 (OLS slope 10 / intercept 100, per-standard is_counts normalization). The shipped through-origin fit gives W-11 = 16.5 instead of 12, so the family rejects it.

Hand-recomputed the blank families. blank_mean: 3.5 with a blank after the samples. blank_nondetects: the MB-10 exact-mdl blank is a result and MB-37 (0.99999995) is excluded. blank_single_result: level 3, while the shipped first-blank value is 0.5. blank_no_results: fallback to the first blank's reading, including negative -1.0 and a blank after the sample.

Hand-recomputed dilution.jsonl (blank removed before dilution: 5/50/5000/388.5; the shipped reading*dil-level formula differs) and flag_basis.jsonl (flag on the corrected reading, not the amount: W-81 ND with amount 5, W-82 J with amount 12).

Hand-recomputed flag_limits.jsonl. Corrected reading exactly mdl gives J, exactly loq gives '', mdl==loq gives '', and values 5e-8 on either side give ND/J/''. All inputs are dyadic (is_counts 1024, slope 10 / intercept 100), so any standard OLS formulation reproduces the exact boundaries.
Hand-recomputed negative_readings.jsonl. A clamp-to-zero implementation turns W-103 into ND and changes blank_levels, so the family rejects it.

Hand-recomputed ccv_limits.jsonl. 90.0 and 110.00000000000001 pass (inclusive), 110.04 and 89.96 pass only with rounding, and 110.06 and 89.94 fail. Reported recovery must be unrounded (110.04 vs 110.0 exceeds the 1.1e-4 bound).

Traced ccv_bracketing.jsonl. W-111 (prior pass, next fail) is false, which rejects the shipped look-back-only rule. W-112 (prior fail, next pass) rejects a look-ahead-only rule. W-113 rejects an any-CCV-on-either-side rule.

Traced ccv_unbracketed.jsonl. Samples before the first CCV give true (even when that CCV fails: W-128), samples after the last CCV inherit the preceding CCV (pass and fail variants), and a batch with no CCVs gives true. generated-2 row 1 (R710-19 Se after an 89.96 CCV) confirms that the inherited pass uses the SOP rounded criterion.

Hand-recomputed spike_recovery.jsonl (both results: denominator = added without dilution, so the shipped added*dilution gives 50 instead of 100) and spike_nondetects.jsonl (ND spike or parent: SOP amounts with the shipped added*dilution denominator, e.g. 48.75, -16.04, -15.0, 52.5). Spot-checked the same split in report_order row 1 (As 47.5 / Cd 50 vs Pb 160), generated-1 rows 3 and 5, and capacity R632-76 (both ND).

Traced report_order.jsonl. Analyte order Tl, As, Pb, Cd is non-alphabetical and run ids are non-sorted, sample and spike runs are interleaved in run order, and per-analyte ccv_ok differs within one run (a CCV fails Tl/Pb only), so a per-run ccv_ok is rejected.

Checked the domain limits (SOP 1) against the generated and capacity batches: CCV true >= 10*loq, recoveries between 79.99 and 125, rounding margins >= ~0.01 from any .x5 tie, and counts, dilution and is_counts in range. The capacity batch has 80 runs, 4 analytes and 8 standards, as asserted at tests/test_outputs.py:201.

Checked the execution path. The verifier-owned driver at /opt/driver links src to /app/src and runs with python3 -I -S as nobody with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, so candidate source is re-imported fresh (no stale-binary path). test_driver_is_unchanged enforces the byte-identity promise from instruction.md:3.

Estimated floating-point sensitivity: well-conditioned OLS variants differ by far less than the 1e-6 relative/absolute bounds, including large spike recoveries divided by small added amounts. No false-rejection path was identified. This is a static estimate, not an execution.

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to an assertion that fails when it is missing or reversed
coverage_sweep.reason: Each SOP section (2 OLS with intercept, 3 readings/non-clamping/result threshold, 4 blank mean anywhere, 5 corrected/amount/flags, 6 CCV rounding and bracketing, 7 spike recovery, 8 report shape/order) has a dedicated family whose expected outcome differs from the shipped code and from the natural wrong variants traced in checks_performed.

coverage_sweep.category: Check the full core result, not just existence/keys/row count
coverage_sweep.reason: compare() checks every value of every entry in all four sections plus blank_levels, with an exact key set and positional order. There is no existence-only or count-only check.

coverage_sweep.category: Named domain rule has an isolating case (not only held-out variation)
coverage_sweep.reason: Hand-built isolating fixtures cover: exact mdl/loq, mdl==loq, blank exactly at mdl, blanks after samples, non-detect blanks, a single blank result, no blank results, negative readings, dilution 1/10/37/1000, rounding-inclusive CCV limits, all bracketing sides, spikes with result and ND parents/spikes, and spike dilution different from the parent's.

Traced rejection of: the unchanged shipped package, a through-origin fit, first-blank level, blank subtracted after dilution, flags on the amount, J at exactly loq, a strict CCV range, an inclusive range without rounding, a rounded reported recovery, look-back-only / look-ahead-only / any-CCV bracketing, dilution in the result-spike denominator, the SOP formula applied to ND spikes, null recovery for ND, clamping of negatives, per-run ccv_ok, and sorted output.

coverage_sweep.category: Contract-valid alternatives (format, ordering, implementation choices) are accepted
coverage_sweep.reason: JSON is parsed, not text-compared. blank_levels key order is free. int vs float are both accepted for numbers. The numeric tolerance matches instruction.md:7. Boundary fixtures use dyadic values, so alternative OLS/reading formulations produce identical boundary results. List order and the exact entry key sets are what SOP 8 prescribes.

coverage_sweep.category: Documented restrictions and lifecycle behavior enforced
coverage_sweep.reason: The driver-unchanged promise is enforced by a byte comparison. The 'add no correction/qualifier/guard' restriction is enforced through full-value comparisons that fail on added clamps, exclusions, or null recoveries. The 'keep shipped calculation' gaps (no blank results, unbracketed runs, ND spike recovery) each have dedicated families.

coverage_sweep.category: Proxy behavior, Oracle-specific representation, stale binaries, self-controlled comparisons, unreachable cases
coverage_sweep.reason: Goldens are sealed under /tests (chmod 700) with digests pinned in ROSTER, and the batches are not in the candidate environment (.dockerignore excludes tests/). The verifier runs its own driver copy against fresh source with -I -S as nobody. Every fixture lies within the SOP 1 limits.

coverage_sweep.category: State-machine initialization-to-first-event (bracketing before the first CCV, blanks before/after samples)
coverage_sweep.reason: Samples before the first CCV (including before a failing CCV), batches with no CCVs, and blanks positioned after all samples are all graded and discriminate the wrong variants.

coverage_sweep.category: Signed derived quantities: sign partitions discriminated
coverage_sweep.reason: Negative and positive blank levels, negative corrected readings, and negative and positive spike recoveries (e.g. -150, -15, 380) are all graded with sign-sensitive tolerances.
The verifier grades parsed JSON values and does not constrain whitespace, key order within blank_levels, or number encoding. Exact key sets and list order are retained promises of SOP 8.

rules: SOP 3 non-detect results / instruction keep-shipped gap
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: All blanks non-detect (including negative readings and a blank placed after the sample): the level falls back to the first blank's reading. When at least one result exists: mean of results only.
A large dilution raises the amount above loq while the corrected reading is below mdl or loq (W-81, W-84, W-82): the flag must follow the corrected reading.

Mixed result and ND analytes within the same spike run (report_order B-SPK, generated-1 R910-3): the SOP formula applies to result pairs and the shipped added*dilution formula (with SOP amounts) to ND pairs.

rules: SOP 6 CCV pass on rounded recovery
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: An unbracketed sample after a CCV whose recovery of 89.96 passes only under SOP rounding (generated-2 R710-19 Se is true): the inherited pass uses the SOP criterion.

rules: SOP 8 order within run by analytes
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: A CCV fails Tl and Pb but passes As and Cd, with the analyte list in non-alphabetical order: ccv_ok differs per analyte in the declared order.
A blank exactly at mdl is included in the mean, and a blank 5e-8 below mdl is excluded.
